svg.title: A control matrix naming which party may start each primitive
svg.desc: Three rows, tools, resources and prompts, against three columns, the model, the host and the user, with the wire method in a fourth column. Exactly one square per row is filled and carries a play mark, meaning that party starts the interaction: the model starts tools, the host starts resources, the user starts prompts. The remaining squares carry a bar, meaning that party can block it, a faint dotted mark, meaning it may take part, or a bare dash, meaning it does not choose. Closing notes state that the model never picks a server, only a tool, and that whoever starts an interaction the host can still refuse it, because the matrix names who may begin one and never who may stop one.
svg.text: One party per row may start it. Every path still runs through the host.
